prayerExcerpt.en-US: "Do not doubt: God will help you. I will not abandon you."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Não duvideis: Deus vos assistirá. Não vos abandonarei."

meta.face: A tall Palermitan noblewoman of about sixty with a pale olive complexion and a LONG, NARROW, fine-boned face — a smooth, high forehead under the wimple, dark brows that slope DOWN at their outer ends, large dark eyes whose outer corners DROOP a little, giving a gentle, sorrowful look, a LONG, slender nose with a high, straight bridge, a LONG upper lip, lightly hollowed cheeks and hollow temples, a SMALL, full, closed mouth and a narrow, tapering chin; the gaze grave and kind, toward us.
meta.basis: Her photograph (the Dicastery's portrait and Wikimedia's headshot, before 1923): a long, narrow face with a long, high-bridged nose, large dark eyes with drooping outer corners, a long upper lip and a small mouth, in a black veil and white wimple. A sister's memory, quoted by Famiglia Cristiana, calls her tall, with fine features. The loaf is for her door-to-door alms among the poor of Palermo and Cinisi.
meta.excerpt: Her last words to her sisters, «non dubitate. Iddio vi assisterà… Non vi abbandonerò», as reported by Famiglia Cristiana (2022); our rendering, shortened at the ellipses (she died in 1923)
